lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: All 5 stories of CAM-236 (US-R1-001, US-001 through US-004) now pass. The PRD is complete pending re-review of round 1's fix.

Ship gotcha carried over from US-004's notes (unchanged by this story): the currently-INSTALLED cam binary (pre-this-PR) still compares === 'none' internally, so this PR's own `cam ship --finalize` may read 'local' from the now-migrated project.toml and skip the local issue-file close for CAM-236 -- the operator/orchestrator may need to close the issue file manually or rebuild+reinstall the binary before shipping this PRD.

Two remaining 'none' mentions stay deliberately out of AC scope (carried over from US-004): `.claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md:72` (`issue_system = none` in an edge-case checklist bullet) and `scripts/cam/patterns.md:46` (the finalizeCycleClose hardening bullet, itself a knowledge doc not a code path).

scripts/build-release.sh AC4 smoke still passes '--issue-system none' to the compiled binary (carried over from US-001/US-002/US-003; still out of scope -- no story in CAM-236 touched build-release.sh).
nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 resolved review round 1's single CRITICAL finding: US-001's AC1 named-command oracle was pinned to `src/commands/setup.ts` for the `IssueSystem` union literal, but US-002 (a later, already-passed story) legitimately relocated that literal to `src/config/issue-system.ts:24` and left setup.ts as a bare re-export -- so the oracle string stopped matching even though the type itself was untouched and typecheck stayed green throughout. Fix was PRD-only: retargeted US-001's AC1 oracle text/grep-target to `src/config/issue-system.ts` (verified green: `grep -q "'linear' | 'github' | 'local'" src/config/issue-system.ts`); zero production code changed. No new code surface for the next reviewer round to inspect beyond re-running all 5 stories' oracles fresh. All quality gates (typecheck, bun test 3951 pass/0 fail, bun run check:all incl. biome lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) are green on this commit.
